description.narrative:
IFC anticipates that the Project would result in increased access to seed/early-stage equity financing and value-addition services for technology startups in Georgia and the other Program Countries, potentially resulting in business growth.
Beyond the Project, this investment has the potential to contribute to creating a competitive digital entrepreneurship ecosystem in Georgia and the other Program Countries, by supporting the development of local venture capital markets. This would be achieved through demonstrating the commercial viability of the VC fund model, developing a quality pipeline of investment projects, and building entrepreneurial skills and networks.

The proposed project consists of an IFC equity commitment of up to US 4 million in 500 Georgia, L.P. (500 Georgia or the the Fund), a venture capital (VC) fund focusing on pre-seed and seed investments in companies participating in the 500 Georgia Program and/or operating in Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bosnia & Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, the Czech Republic, Estonia, Georgia, Greece, Hungary, Kosovo, Kyrgyzstan, Latvia, Lithuania, Kazakhstan, Republic of Macedonia, Moldova, Montenegro, Poland, Romania, Serbia, the Slovak Republic, Slovenia, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Ukraine and Uzbekistan (the Program Countries).
